title: Custom Office & Business Furniture | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Custom furniture for offices, receptions, meeting rooms and executive offices. Design, production and installation in Bratislava and Vienna.

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) specializes in the design and production of custom-made furniture for commercial interiors. We develop individual furniture solutions based on the architecture of the space, business requirements, functionality, ergonomics, and corporate identity.

We create custom furniture for offices, retail stores, boutiques, beauty salons, showrooms, and other commercial properties. Each project is developed individually — from the initial concept and technical solutions to manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Custom Office Furniture For offices and corporate spaces, we design custom furniture that helps organize an efficient working environment while maintaining a consistent interior style.
We design:
— reception desks;
— executive desks and office furniture;
— employee workstations and desks;
— meeting and conference tables;
— cabinets and storage systems;
— office kitchens;
— furniture for lounge areas;
— built-in furniture;
— decorative and wall panels.
Dimensions, configurations, materials, hardware, and internal storage solutions are developed individually for each space.
Custom Furniture for Retail Stores & Boutiques For retail stores, boutiques, and showrooms, we design custom retail furniture that combines functionality with the visual identity of the brand.
We develop display units, shelving, retail counters, checkout areas, storage systems, fitting rooms, decorative panels, and other custom elements for retail interiors.
Special attention is given to customer and staff convenience, product presentation, and efficient use of available retail space.
Furniture for Beauty Salons We design custom furniture for beauty salons, studios, and other service-oriented commercial spaces.
Solutions may include reception desks, workstations, cabinets, storage systems, customer waiting areas, decorative elements, and built-in furniture.
The design takes into account workflow ergonomics, intensive everyday use, and the specific requirements of each business.
Individual Furniture Design Every piece of furniture is designed according to the dimensions and architecture of the property.
We carefully develop construction details, proportions, materials, hardware, opening systems, internal organization, and the relationship between furniture and other elements of the interior.
This approach allows us to use the available space efficiently and create furniture that becomes an integral part of the overall architectural concept.
Furniture Drawings & Technical Documentation For custom furniture manufacturing, we prepare detailed working drawings and technical specifications.
The documentation defines dimensions, construction solutions, materials, internal organization, hardware, and other parameters required for production.
This allows technical details to be resolved before manufacturing and helps ensure that the finished furniture corresponds to the approved design.
Materials & Hardware Materials are selected according to the design concept, purpose of the furniture, operating conditions, and project budget.
For commercial furniture, particular attention is given to durability, practicality, ease of maintenance, and the reliability of construction systems and hardware.
We select materials and components to combine aesthetics, functionality, and long-term performance.
Furniture as Part of the Commercial Interior Custom furniture can support a company's corporate identity and become an important part of the visual character of the space.
Colors, materials, shapes, decorative elements, and brand graphics can be integrated into the furniture design and coordinated with the overall interior concept.
This is particularly important for reception areas, stores, boutiques, showrooms, and other spaces where the interior directly interacts with customers.

Manufacturing, Delivery & Installation DUMSKAYA DESIGN offers a comprehensive approach — from furniture concept development and technical design to manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation at the property. This approach helps ensure that the finished products correspond to the approved design and technical documentation.
We create individual furniture solutions for commercial properties with careful consideration of functionality, ergonomics, aesthetics, and specific business requirements.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — custom furniture design and manufacturing for offices, retail stores, boutiques, beauty salons, showrooms, and other commercial interiors.
